_help: Narration for the three films and the sample, one line per scene. scripts/narrate.mjs speaks each line with Kokoro (British English voice) to public/audio/<film>/<id>.wav and records its length in public/audio/timings.json; the Remotion compositions size each scene from those lengths. 'say' is what the voice reads (spelling out the web address); 'text' is the caption. Every claim was checked against the working app and website on 10 October 2026: see docs/commercial-2026/07-video-scripts-storyboards.md.

flagship.text: On a busy shift, you scan when the patient needs it. But your supervisor is in the resuscitation room, on nights, or at another site. The review never quite happens, and the logbook falls behind.
flagship.say: On a busy shift, you scan when the patient needs it. But your supervisor is in the resuscitation room, on nights, or at another site. The review never quite happens, and the logbook falls behind.

flagship.text: Wavelength is an ultrasound logbook designed for real clinical practice.
flagship.say: Wavelength is an ultrasound logbook, designed for real clinical practice.

flagship.text: Choose the pathways you're working towards, from RCEM and FAMUS to FUSIC and international frameworks.
flagship.say: Choose the pathways you're working towards, from R C E M and FAY-mus, to FEW-sick and international frameworks.

flagship.text: Log a scan in moments: the application, your findings, how you were supervised, and an image if you have one. It works offline, and you remove identifiers before anything is saved.
flagship.say: Log a scan in moments. The application, your findings, how you were supervised, and an image if you have one. It works offline, and you remove identifiers before anything is saved.

flagship.text: Link the supervisors you work with, and see who is verified by Wavelength, and for which modules.
flagship.say: Link the supervisors you work with, and see who is verified by Wavelength, and for which modules.

flagship.text: Send scans for review. Your supervisor opens them on their own phone when they're free, confirms or queries each one, and signs. Required bedside supervision and assessments still happen in person.
flagship.say: Send your scans for review. Your supervisor opens them on their own phone when they're free, confirms or queries each one, and signs. Where your pathway needs bedside supervision, or an observed assessment, that still happens in person.

flagship.text: Every sign-off and assessment updates your progress. When you're ready, export a portfolio with a QR code that reviewers can check online.
flagship.say: Every sign-off and assessment updates your progress. When you're ready, export a portfolio, with a QR code that reviewers can check online.
